purpose: Binary clip classification pilot with 150 examples per class

selection_method.PUBG: Use both experiment 3 CSVs as the inventory. Exclude nogun. Assign each weapon label to one split as a proxy group. Sample roughly evenly across eligible weapon labels in each split.
selection_method.controlled_firearm: Sample one clip per original recording ID. Use session 1 for training and validation and session 2 for testing. Sample roughly evenly across the four labelled categories within each split.

limitations: PUBG weapon labels are proxy groups. The metadata does not establish whether different labels share game audio assets.
Different original recording IDs from session 1 may contain the same event captured by different devices. Validation is exploratory. The held-out range session is the independent session check.
Only one dataset represents each class. Performance can reflect dataset characteristics even with these splits.
